subject: Audit log evidence — export package and delivery options
messages:
From: Jordan Brooks <jordan.brooks@acmehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@acmehealth.com
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 16:03:00 -0400
Subject: Request: admin activity logs + export options for SOC2 audit

Karthik — thanks for the quick intro earlier. Our SOC2 auditor has asked for the admin activity trail and evidence showing exportability for the last 90 days (focus on user management, IAM changes, role grants, API key creation, and sessions).

High level asks: 
- What events are captured (exact field names/keys) for admin actions?
- Retention policy for raw logs and for the admin/activity ledger?
- Supported export formats and delivery mechanics (S3, signed GDrive link, encrypted archive)?
- Are there pre-built bundles you provide for auditors (manifest + mapping to SIG/CAIQ controls)?

We need this by COB 2027-04-12. If there are existing redacted samples we can use in the packet that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Jordan
Lead InfoSec, Acme Health
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Brooks <jordan.brooks@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity logs + export options for SOC2 audit

Jordan — looping in Evelyn (Security) and Laura (Legal) to make sure we cover the mapping and any redaction/legal constraints. Quick summary so you have something to share with the auditor immediately: 

1) What we log (examples):
- admin.user.create, admin.user.delete, admin.role.grant, api_key.create, api_key.revoke, session.start, session.end
- Each event includes: timestamp_utc, user_email, user_id (hashed), ip_address (first 3 octets masked on export by default), request_id, resource_path, change_summary (json string)

2) Retention:
- Activity ledger (high-fidelity events): 13 months by default; configurable for Dedicated/Private deployments.
- Aggregate telemetry (metrics): 25 months.
- Snapshots for audits: we can produce point-in-time snapshots and freeze a copy for your records.

3) Export formats & delivery:
- CSV (column schema), newline-delimited JSON (ndjson), and compressed TAR.GZ bundles.
- Delivery: S3 PUT (pre-signed uploads to your bucket), encrypted GDrive folder (enterprise‑managed link), or PGP-encrypted email attachments (for smaller bundles).

4) Mapping:
- We include a manifest.txt that maps event names to SIG/CAIQ control IDs and SOC2 criteria (e.g., admin.role.grant -> SIG 1.2.3 / SOC2 CC6.1).

We can produce a redacted sample export (removes PII, masks IPs, and hashes user IDs) — Evelyn, can you confirm the earliest we can deliver a 1-month redacted sample plus the full 90-day export?

—Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Brooks <jordan.brooks@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 14:27:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity logs + export options for SOC2 audit

Jordan / Karthik — confirmed. Delivery plan and notes below.

Delivery timeline:
- Redacted 30-day sample: 2027-04-10 11:00 EDT (attached manifest + sample CSV)
- Full 90-day export (encrypted tar.gz): 2027-04-11 EOD, delivered via pre-signed S3 PUT to an Acme-managed bucket (we will send the pre-signed URL + short-lived credentials).

Redaction & masking rules in sample:
- user_id hashed with salted HMAC (salt stored separately in key vault),
- email addresses truncated to domain for internal users,
- IPs masked to first three octets (e.g., 192.0.2.xxx),
- api_key values omitted; event retains api_key.create without token string.

Attachments in sample package: export_manifest.txt (schema + event->control mapping), redacted_admin_activity_2027-03-01_2027-03-31.csv (sample), sig_caij_mapping.pdf (control matrix).

Evelyn Hart
Director, Platform Security
Redwood Inference
